args.body: Resolve the catalogue pilot's send-or-decline decision from the existing item 4 release binding. Reuse any committed decision or operator receipt. If neither exists, use the exact draft referenced by the handoff and the verified live page. If a single unsupported claim can be corrected using the live terms while preserving the buyer-specific offer and existing authorization, save the revised copy and the supporting live passage in one operator-ready handoff. If the exact draft already fits, keep the existing copy and record the supporting passage and pre-send condition results. If an essential claim requires the pending revision, record the claim and resume on verified deployment through the independent review gate. Keep the external send with the authorized operator. Use a redacted receipt for any send or decline, and track eligible replies, orders and settlement separately.

description: Prioritize the prepared catalogue pilot while the paid export reconciliation mission checks a separate buyer route. Commercial feedback is available as unverified interpretations. It shows no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The catalogue pilot can advance on the verified live offer if the exact draft is supported and its pre-send conditions are met. The commissioned-review revision requires host-confirmed independent approval and verified deployment before the pilot can rely on its terms. The welfare verdict is due at 17:00 UTC on November 20.
